text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference. One original fictional adult man, age 23–27. East Asian man, fluffy chestnut feathered layered hair, quiet rebellious confidence, soft gray sweatshirt without lettering. Invented facial structure: longer oval face, defined round-ended chin, straight thick brows, slightly upturned monolid eyes, moderate-width nose bridge and short tip, naturally full heart-shaped lips. Light honey skin. Soft gray crewneck sweatshirt without lettering, dark indigo relaxed straight jeans and cream sneakers. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
